thread:
eli: Heads-up: PR #502 (SDK examples + migration note) ready for review. Planning to merge today but want to confirm previews. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/502

marco: I'll check Netlify and Vercel previews. Which branch is it on?

eli: branch is docs/sdk-migration-502

vercel-bot: Preview deployed: https://vercel.com/redwood/docs/preview/9001 

marco: Vercel preview looks good, snippets render and examples are present. Netlify preview shows 500 on build step though. Logs say "Error: EACCES: permission denied, copyfile 'static/examples'"

anya: That permission issue sounds like the Netlify cache layer wrote files as root in a prior run. I've seen this before. Quick workaround: add `--no-cache` in Netlify build or clear cache from site UI.

eli: I pushed a tiny change to the Netlify build command to include `--no-cache` for now and retriggered.

netlify-bot: Deploy queued (site: redwood-docs)

marco: While we wait, can someone run the link-check locally? I ran `pnpm docs:linkcheck` and got one broken internal anchor on /guides/upgrade. Noticed the anchor id changed after the migration note edits.

eli: Good catch. I pushed a fix that restores the old anchor and added a redirect in the same page.

netlify-bot: Deploy succeeded  preview URL: https://deploy-preview-502--redwood-docs.netlify.app

marco: Netlify preview passes now. Running `pnpm docs:linkcheck` on CI as well.

ci-bot: GitHub Actions: docs-preview workflow completed  link-check: passed, build: passed, deploy-preview: succeeded

anya: @eli when are you merging? I prefer waiting for 30 minutes post-merge to catch any alerts.

eli: Plan: merge at 17:30 UTC after a final eyeball and approvals. @marco can you approve the PR?

marco: Approved.

eli: Merged at 1780001390. I'll monitor alerts and rollback if anything pops up.

anya: Thanks. Filing follow-up to add a CI smoke step that curls a few canonical pages after deploy so we catch 500s earlier.
